name: Gym Membership Expiry Report
query:
SELECT
  `tabGym Membership`.name as "Membership:Link/Gym Membership:130",
  `tabGym Membership`.full_name as "Member Name:Data:150",
  `tabGym Membership`.phone__number as "Phone Number:Data:120",
  `tabGym Membership`.date_of_registration as "Starts:Date:110",
  `tabGym Membership`.membership_ends as "Ends:Date:110",
  DATEDIFF(`tabGym Membership`.membership_ends, CURDATE()) as "Days Left:Int:100",
  `tabGym Membership`.fee_paid as "Payment Status:Select/Paid,Unpaid,Partially Paid:120",
  `tabGym Membership`.total_amount as "Total Amount:Currency:110",
  `tabGym Membership`.balance as "Balance:Currency:100"
FROM `tabGym Membership`
WHERE `tabGym Membership`.docstatus = 1
  AND `tabGym Membership`.membership_ends IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `tabGym Membership`.membership_ends ASC
